ModMetaData.name: Romance On The Rim - Wedding Fix
ModMetaData.author: JG
ModMetaData.description: Compatibility fixes for Romance On The Rim 1.6 weddings: restores active wedding LordJobs after save/load, rebuilds procession pairings lost by RotR serialization, and counts attendance against the actual ceremony duration instead of the fixed 10,000-tick ritual duration.
